chapter: Tulsa bands, Trent, Holder and Kirk
title: Back in Sand Springs helping his brother's Pythian band
summary: After graduating he returns to Sand Springs, where his trumpeter brother leads a Knights of Pythias band and lets him conduct the marching band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: coming, and so everything went on averagly. When I finished, still not dreaming that that would be my career, I came back to Sand Springs--that's where my brother was teaching--and so while I was there he said, well, what are you going to do? I said I'm going to find me a job of something. I'll go around Tulsa and see. He said that's good; one thing, don't worry about it, I want you to be some help to me, Captain Dryer told me that I should be proud of you, that you could help me.
He had a large band, the Pythian Lodge, a large organization that they had and they had pythian band.
Yes. They had a pythian band, and of course he taught in high school at Sand Springs, that's a little suburb town.
I went there and then for a while he would go and he would see me going on little trips and sometimes he turn the band over to me,
the marching band, over to me. I liked that.
Did your brother play an instrument?
Yes, he was a trumpet player. Remember, I told you before, Captain Dryer said why in the world did Clarence let you come here without some kind of horn.
